{
  "name": "limits",
  "version": "0.8.0",
  "description": "Claude Code mod: your 5h/7d quota, context window, prompt-cache time left and session cost on one line above the prompt, with per-subagent cost on hover",
  "author": {
    "name": "Andrei Shivalin",
    "url": "https://github.com/VaitaR"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/VaitaR/claude-code-limits",
  "repository": "https://github.com/VaitaR/claude-code-limits",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "claude-code-plugin",
    "rate-limits",
    "usage-limits",
    "context-window",
    "prompt-cache",
    "cost",
    "statusline",
    "subagents"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "cacheTtl": {
      "title": "Prompt cache TTL",
      "description": "How long the main loop's prompt cache lives after its last response: 1h with extended caching, 5m otherwise",
      "type": "string",
      "options": [
        "1h",
        "5m"
      ],
      "default": "1h"
    },
    "palette": {
      "title": "Palette",
      "description": "theme follows your Claude Code theme (light, dark, colour-blind); pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals",
      "type": "string",
      "options": [
        "theme",
        "pastel"
      ],
      "default": "theme"
    },
    "costCommand": {
      "title": "Cost split command",
      "description": "Command that prints a session's cost split by main thread and subagent as JSON (see the README); the session id is appended. Empty: the cost hover shows the total only",
      "type": "string",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
